tokens.npc_dota_hero_warlock_bio: As Chief Curator and Head of Acquisitions for the Arcane Archives of the Ultimyr Academy, Demnok Lannik was tireless in his pursuit of lost, rare and forbidden tomes. No cursed temple was so foreboding, no cavern path so treacherous, that any concern for his own survival could dissuade him from entering if rumors hinted that some pamphlet of primordial lore might still survive in its depths. However, so often did his investigations trigger the wrath of protector entities, that he finally found it necessary to master the arts of magic. He bent himself to learning sorcery with the same thorough obsessiveness that marked his quest for incunabula, becoming the most powerful Warlock of the Academy in less time than most practitioners required to complete a course of undergraduate work. Almost as an afterthought, he carved a staff of Dreadwood and summoned into it a captive spirit from the Outer Hells. And anticipating the day when he will have recovered every last lost spellbook, he has commenced writing his own Black Grimoire. It will undoubtedly be instructive.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_warlock_hype: Summoning forth his demonic golem, Warlock brings ruin to enemies and destroys their defenses. Yet even without his golem, his dark spells can still wreak havoc, whether healing allies and harming enemies with a word, or binding foes together to share their agony.

No cursed temple was so foreboding, no cavern path so treacherous, that any concern for his own survival could dissuade him from entering if rumors hinted that some pamphlet of primordial lore might still survive in its depths. However, so often did his investigations trigger the wrath of protector entities, that he finally found it necessary to master the arts of magic. He bent himself to learning sorcery with the same thorough obsessiveness that marked his quest for incunabula, becoming the most powerful Warlock of the Academy in less time than most practitioners required to complete a course of undergraduate work. Almost as an afterthought, he carved a staff of Dreadwood and summoned into it a captive spirit from the Outer Hells. And anticipating the day when he will have recovered every last lost spellbook, he has commenced writing his own Black Grimoire. It will undoubtedly be instructive.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
** All ability effects, including the shared damage distance, are applied immediately within the bounce distance despite the visual effects, and cannot be {{M|disjointed}}.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|warlock_fatal_bonds}}
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Bounce-to}}
**** Has the following bounce distance properties:
***** The first bounce distance is centered around the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted enemy and searches for an unaffected enemy unit.
***** Subsequent unit searches are centered around the affected enemy unit.
*** Has the following enemy search priorities:
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} Unaffected Enemy Units {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} Nearest Enemy Units
***** Can only affect the same enemy units once per cast.
***** The debuff can be reapplied on the same enemy units if no other previously affected enemy units are within the bounce distance.
***** Each applied debuff works independent of each other.
*** Affects the following units:
**** {{M|Untargetable}} units, and explicitly to {{A|Dark Willow|Shadow Realm}}-affected units.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Fogged units}}.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Damage|Shared}}
*** Shares the same [[damage type]] as the source damage ([[before reductions]]), with the following flags:
**** {{M|HP Removal}}
**** {{M|No-reflection}}
**** Shared {{M|physical}} damage is explicitly not affected by {{M|damage block}} sources.
*** The damage value interacts with the following sources:
**** {{M|On-damage effects}}.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***** {{M|Outgoing damage|t=p}} manipulation sources on Warlock.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** {{M|Incoming damage|t=n}} manipulation on the affected enemy unit.
***** Does not share {{M|HP Removal}} sources damage instance.
****** {{M|Instant kill}} sources share a 0-damage instance to all affected units.
***** Shares the overkill damage value, if the damage source exceeds the affected unit's {{M|current health}}.
*** The following units do not react to the shared damage:
**** {{M|Neutral creeps}}.
**** Non-player-controlled units.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Channeling}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Aura}}
** [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
*** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Upheaval cast range}}|v1={{#var:Upheaval value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t1l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1+{{#var:Upheaval cast range}}|v1={{#var:Upheaval value1 tal}}}}|10tal}})-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
** {{Symbol|a|up}}
*** Creates a negative [[aura]] upon cast at the {{Symbol|Target|Area}} area-targeted location with incrementing ability values per Warlock's [[channeling]] {{M|server tick}}, starting {{#expr:{{G|tick rate}} round3}} seconds upon cast, up to its respective max values.
*** In short, the max ability values are achieved in the following N<sup>th</sup> second:
**** The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} at the 4/5/6/11<sup>th</sup> second per level
**** The {{M|movement speed}} slow at the 5<sup>th</sup> second on each level.
**** {{cf|talnotes}} The ally {{Symbol|bonus t2r}}{{M|attack speed}} bonus at the 7<sup>th</sup> second on each level.
**** {{cf|shdnotes}} Now summons {{ValueColor||{{#var:Upheaval type2 value1 shd}}|shd}} {{U|Minor Imp}} of the current {{A|Warlock|Eldritch Summoning}} ability level per {{ValueColor||{{#var:Upheaval type2 value2 shd}}|shd}}-second channel time.
***** Hence, it can summon a max {{ValueColor||{{calc|(v1/{{#var:Upheaval type2 value2 shd}})-1|v1={{#var:Upheaval value2}}}}|shd}} Minor Imps for the entire duration per cast.
** {{Symbol|Channeling}}
*** Has an effective {{calc|v1-{{#var:Upheaval basic1}}|v1={{#var:Upheaval value2}}}}-second max channel time.
*** The {{Code|MaxChannelTime - 1}}<sup>th</sup> second ability value is not applied. However, the [[aura]] has a {{#var:Upheaval value5}}-second linger duration.
**** All ability value calculations below factors the last missing {{#var:Upheaval basic1}}-second interval.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|warlock_upheaval}}
** From the same source, the debuff values are applied or reapplied, and refreshed in the same intervals.
** {{cf|talnotes}}
*** This is also applied to the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|warlock_upheaval_ally}} {{M|attack speed}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}}.
**** Hence, it immediately updates the current instance.
*** {{Symbol|bonus t3l}} Increases both the damage increment per second and max damage per second component.
**** Does not update the current instance.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Acquiring the {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} immediately updates the current instance.

mechanics
fields.value:
{{Spellunit
| innate = true;1;1
| name = Warlock Golem
| desc0 = The Golem from the depths is both an ancient creep and a creep-hero. Certain abilities may react differently on this unit.

| icon1 = Warlock Warlock Golem Flaming Fists
| type1 = bsc
| target1 = Passive
| desc1 = This unit's attacks deal pure damage to enemy units within the radius.

| type1 traitamp = aoe
| type1 trait1 = Radius
| type1 value1 = {{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Flaming Fists|value1}}
| type1 trait2 = Damage
| type1 value2 = {{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Flaming Fists|value2}}

| icon2 = Warlock Warlock Golem Permanent Immolation
| type2 = bsc
| target2 = Passive
| desc2 = Enemy units getting too close will be immolated.

| type2 traitamp = aoe
| type2 trait1 = Radius
| type2 value1 = {{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation|value1}}
| type2 trait2 = Base Damage per Second
| type2 value2 = {{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation|value2}}
| type2 trait3 = Aura Linger Duration
| type2 value3 = {{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation|value3}}
}}
* Has the following additional unit properties:
** {{Symbol|bonus aoe}}
*** The unit's ablities are affected by [[area-of-effect]] manipulation sources on Warlock.
** {{A|Warlock Golem|Flaming Fists}}
*** Applies {{M|pure}} {{M|spell damage}} within the radius centered around the attack target per attack.
** {{A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation}}
*** Deals {{calc|v1*0.5|v1={{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation|value2}}}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in 0.5-second intervals, starting 0.5 seconds upon debuff application for the unit's entire duration, over {{#expr:{{#var:Chaotic Offering type1 value3}}/0.5+1}} damage instances.
** {{cf|talnotes}} Applies a generic {{M|incoming damage}} reduction on the Warlock Golem.
*** Stacks additively with other incoming damage manipulation sources.
*** Does not affect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.

* [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{calc|v1+{{#var:Chaotic Offering cast range}}|v1={{#var:Chaotic Offering value1}}}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and {{M|stun}} radius.
** The {{U|Warlock Golem}} is always summoned at point [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] , the center of the {{Symbol|Target|Area}} area-targeted location {{M|Facing Angle|text=facing}} [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]].
*** The following sources do not update the current summoned instance:
**** Leveling up the ability.
**** The {{ValueColor||incoming damage resistance increasing|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3r}}.
**** Each ability cast summons an independent Warlock Golem instance.
** {{Symbol|Trees}}
*** [[Trees]] within the {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} effect radius centered around the Warlock Golem, or the {{Symbol|Target|Area}} area-targeted location are destroyed.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Couriers}}

* {{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{cf|talnotes}} Summons a regular Golem upon {{ValueColor||Warlock's death passively|25tal}} with the following properties:
*** Works independently of Chaotic Offering's {{M|cooldown}}, lasts for its full duration, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
*** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
*** Does not proc on {{M|reincarnation}} sources.
*** All other {{U|Warlock Golem}} {{M|talent|t=t3r|text=talents}} apply.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Summons another {{U|Warlock Golem}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Chaotic Offering value4 agh}}|agh}} seconds after the first golem.
** Has a total {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Chaotic Offering value4 agh}}+{{#var:Chaotic Offering value3}}}}|agh}}-second {{M|stun}} duration with the effect delay.
** The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} only upgrades the manual ability cast.

*** Deals {{calc|v1*0.5|v1={{Show|A|Warlock Golem|Permanent Immolation|value2}}}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} in 0.5-second intervals, starting 0.5 seconds upon debuff application for the unit's entire duration, over {{#expr:{{#var:Chaotic Offering type1 value3}}/0.5+1}} damage instances.

**** Leveling up the ability.

** {{Symbol|Trees}}
*** [[Trees]] within the {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} effect radius centered around the Warlock Golem, or the {{Symbol|Target|Area}} area-targeted location are destroyed.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Couriers}}

* {{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** {{cf|talnotes}} Summons a regular Golem upon {{ValueColor||Warlock's death passively|25tal}} with the following properties:

*** All other {{U|Warlock Golem}} {{M|talent|t=t3r|text=talents}} apply.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Summons another {{U|Warlock Golem}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Chaotic Offering value4 agh}}|agh}} seconds after the first golem.
** Has a total {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Chaotic Offering value4 agh}}+{{#var:Chaotic Offering value3}}}}|agh}}-second {{M|stun}} duration with the effect delay.
** The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} only upgrades the manual ability cast.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_warlock
data.bio_loc: As Chief Curator and Head of Acquisitions for the Arcane Archives of the Ultimyr Academy, Demnok Lannik was tireless in his pursuit of lost, rare and forbidden tomes. No cursed temple was so foreboding, no cavern path so treacherous, that any concern for his own survival could dissuade him from entering if rumors hinted that some pamphlet of primordial lore might still survive in its depths. However, so often did his investigations trigger the wrath of protector entities, that he finally found it necessary to master the arts of magic. He bent himself to learning sorcery with the same thorough obsessiveness that marked his quest for incunabula, becoming the most powerful Warlock of the Academy in less time than most practitioners required to complete a course of undergraduate work. Almost as an afterthought, he carved a staff of Dreadwood and summoned into it a captive spirit from the Outer Hells. And anticipating the day when he will have recovered every last lost spellbook, he has commenced writing his own Black Grimoire. It will undoubtedly be instructive.
data.hype_loc: Summoning forth his demonic golem, Warlock brings ruin to enemies and destroys their defenses. Yet even without his golem, his dark spells can still wreak havoc, whether healing allies and harming enemies with a word, or binding foes together to share their agony.
data.npe_desc_loc: Summons powerful demons to fight at his side

abilities.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
abilities.desc_loc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
abilities.lore_loc: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
notes_loc: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: warlock_shadow_word
abilities.desc_loc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.

abilities.name: warlock_upheaval
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
notes_loc: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
abilities.shard_loc: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

abilities.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

abilities.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
abilities.lore_loc: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
facets_loc: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
